limitations: Native Codex tool discovery still exposes the old inventory; deployed MCP has requirement tools used through official SDK
Human linking is intentionally REST-only under Q24; explicit user request authorized these associations, without approving requirements
FR-001…FR-020 are original source identifiers; REQ-n is assigned by ACC
Some broad tasks cover multiple requirements; link is traceability, not a claim of complete implementation
No product code changed or full regression rerun for this data synchronization
